title: Export Knowledge Base in Knowledge
description: Complete the export knowledge base workflow in the Knowledge module using a validated, repeatable process.
prerequisites: You are signed in with admin access or equivalent permissions.
You can open the Knowledge module in the current Ogeemo environment.
Required data inputs for export knowledge base are prepared before starting.
steps: Open the Knowledge module from the main navigation.
Locate the export knowledge base entry point in the module workflow.
Enter or select the required inputs for export knowledge base.
Review the configuration and confirm all required fields are complete.
Run or save the workflow and wait for confirmation feedback.
Record output artifacts and references for audit and follow-up tasks.
validations: Export Knowledge Base completes without warnings or blockers.
Resulting records are visible in the expected Knowledge views.
Any generated output is stored in the expected location with traceable metadata.
commonErrors: Required fields are missing during export knowledge base.
Permission constraints prevent completion of export knowledge base.
Output is created but not linked to the expected workflow context.
recovery: Validate required field inputs and rerun export knowledge base.
Confirm role permissions for admin and retry after access refresh.
Re-open the module, relink output artifacts, and verify final state.

faq.question: When should I rerun export knowledge base?
faq.answer: Rerun after correcting inputs or permissions, then validate output against expected records.

faq.question: How do I confirm export knowledge base is complete?
faq.answer: Use module validation checks, confirm resulting records, and verify supporting artifacts were saved.
